name: Niklas Nguyen
intro: Hej! I'm Niklas, a software engineer{at_job}, mostly working with React, TypeScript and .NET. I love getting lost in the little details, and I like learning from the people I work with.

job.title: Software engineer
text: I turn product ideas into full-stack solutions that feel easy to use, across web, mobile and backend with React, TypeScript, C# and .NET.

I like to follow the whole system, from the first idea through UX, technical design, building and testing, to steady improvements after release. A clear experience for the people using it and tidy data flows under the hood guide my work.
